rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In the joint solemn session of 1 January 2019 (15:02-15:42) Jair Messias Bolsonaro took the constitutional oath and the President of the National Congress (Eunício Oliveira) declared him empossado as President 'para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2019 a 31 de dezembro de 2022'; the Termo de Posse read into the record states that at 15:00 on 1 January 2019 he was solemnly given office.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The minutes and the termo de posse read into the record state that Jair Bolsonaro was elected President of the Republic on 28 October 2018.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address at the same session of 1 January 2019, after the posse, the President of the National Congress referred to 'o ex-Presidente Michel Temer'.
